text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Catching a glimpse of true thrill at the 
Miyako Stakes, Transcend realizes just how 
important a worthy rival is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She approached Wonder Acute to propose 
becoming her number-one rival, but was 
turned down because someone had already 
beaten her to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend sets her sights on the GⅠ 
Champions Cup, where the formidable Espoir 
City will also be running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a high bar for a first GⅠ, but if she 
can claim the crown and make her presence 
known, it'll lead to even greater thrills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To obtain both the data on the Big Three 
and the crown of victory, Transcend and 
her team spring into action.
